title: A Hybrid Edge Cloud Digital Twin for Welfare-Constrained Control in Poultry Production
abstract: arXiv:2608.20367v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Poultry production operates under tightly coupled environmental and biological dynamics, yet commercial climate control remains largely heuristic, limiting welfare assurance and operational efficiency. We introduce an edge-cloud digital twin framework for real-time, welfare-constrained environmental control in poultry facilities. The framework integrates distributed sensing, on-device state estimation, a hybrid physics-data model, and model predictive control to enable anticipatory and adaptive management under practical farm constraints. A grey-box thermodynamic and mass-balance formulation is augmented with a learned residual that captures unmodeled biological variability, including activity-dependent metabolic heat. This hybrid model is embedded within a state-space representation for real-time estimation and control at the edge, while cloud coordination supports cross-farm learning and long-horizon optimization. translated_title: 一种用于家禽生产中福利约束控制的混合边缘云数字孪生框架
translated_abstract: 家禽生产在紧密耦合的环境和生物动力学下运行，然而商业气候控制仍主要依赖启发式方法，限制了福利保障和运营效率。我们引入了一种边缘云数字孪生框架，用于家禽设施中实时、福利约束的环境控制。该框架集成了分布式传感、设备端状态估计、混合物理-数据模型和模型预测控制，以在实际农场约束下实现前瞻性和自适应管理。一种灰箱热力学和质量平衡公式通过学习残差进行增强，以捕捉未建模的生物变异性，包括活动依赖的代谢热。该混合模型嵌入状态空间表示中，用于边缘实时估计和控制，而云协调支持跨农场学习和长时域优化。带宽感知的pro（传输协议）...
tldr: 该论文提出一种结合灰箱物理模型与学习残差的边缘云数字孪生框架，实现家禽生产中实时福利约束的预测性环境控制，兼顾边缘实时性与云端跨场优化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an edge-cloud digital twin framework integrating grey-box physics with learned residuals for real-time welfare-constrained predictive environmental control in poultry production, balancing edge responsiveness and cloud-based cross-farm optimization.
